study: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — Beyond Beta: The Network That Invents Its Economy
research_status: Fresh qualitative screen against the governing Beta/Alpha network charter. Reported source observations are reused; no prior workload, selected policy, outcome or demand calibration is inherited.

evidence_categories.observed_own_work: Source retrieval, table visual inspection and arithmetic only; no customer or human-worker observation.
evidence_categories.reported_external: Published rates, documented tools and provider/association cases.
evidence_categories.calibrated_from_sources: Mapping published service roles to a scoped multidisciplinary comparator and multiplying by exposed hours.
evidence_categories.assumed_or_explored: All project effort, rate discount, support window, demand, buyer value, acceptance, price policy and recurrence.

selected_scope.buyer: Technical owner of a formal non-safety-critical scheduling, batching or planning workflow.
selected_scope.outcome: Purpose-preserving policy module, independent original-constraint checker, held-out comparison, narrow adapter and reproducible manifest.
included: Complete formal input/schema and authorized purpose
Competent current frontier workflow plus appropriate established solver baseline
Pinned environment, narrow I/O adapter and one bounded correction/handoff cycle
excluded: Manual recovery of unstated customer intent
Selling a routine rerun of an available solver as a new invention
Customer secrets or restricted third-party content in shared capsules
selected_scope.automation: Automated provider intake, clarification, validation, correction, packaging and recovery; unresolved semantics cause abstention/defer. No routine human provider review.
selected_scope.recurrence: New admissible problem family, changed distribution/runtime budget or a difficult adaptation campaign. Actual recurrence and demand are unmeasured.
selected_scope.commercial_vs_alpha: A customer may buy a useful Beta-delivered outcome. Incremental Alpha requires separate paired evidence against relevant Beta and already-available capabilities. Human-price savings do not establish Alpha.
selected_scope.network_rights: Shareable admission makes sanitized capability metadata/capsules discoverable to all eligible authenticated network members; actual use remains optional and version/scope/permission checked.
selected_scope.human_matching: The human team delivers the same bounded artifact and evidence, not a full deployed operational system or a research idea alone. Network-specific distribution/admission work is a separate enterprise cost, not inflated into the customer's human comparator.

human_team.effort_evidence: All hours, including failed-search allocation, are assumptions per accepted matched package. They are not per-attempt measured hours and not a GSA project quote.
human_team.effort_rationale: The central 168 hours comprises 132 hours of delivered formulation/build/independent testing/handoff plus 36 hours allocated from unsuccessful search and correction. It is independently retained because this complete bounded scope calls for four distinct responsibilities; it is not a result carried over from a prior simulation. Lower/higher 84/336-hour alternatives expose the wide unknown effort.
human_team.contract_assumption: The economic model may assume matched contingent fees per accepted improved package. Published GSA hourly rates are not contingent acceptance terms. Per-accepted effort includes an assumed failed-search allocation; neither human completion probability nor this commercial contract is calibrated by the source.
human_team.quality: Original constraints plus agreed held-out improvement test against competent baseline, reproducible package and one bounded revision cycle.

rate_stresses.interpretation: Explored discounts to published ceiling rates; no actual negotiated price observed.

human_team.no_double_markup: The reported hourly values are provider bill rates. Do not add a generic overhead/profit multiplier or infer human-only delivery.

pricing_and_buyers.pricing: Decision variable; no inherited discount. The human estimate is an outside-option anchor, not a guaranteed willingness to pay.
pricing_and_buyers.demand_status: Uncalibrated scenario/threshold analysis; no authorized quotes, customer survey, purchasing records or elasticities obtained.
pricing_and_buyers.value_constraint: Buyer value must exceed bid plus switching, integration, delay and expected residual-error costs. A competent available optimizer may leave no paid value for a new invention.
pricing_and_buyers.scope_of_competition: The commercial price comparison is with a matched human multidisciplinary service. Competitive pricing against other AI providers is outside this comparison. Strong algorithm baselines remain mandatory within the technical evaluation.

buyer_value_illustration.formula: recoverable_value = reducible_billed_resource_hours * resource_unit_price * measured_or_assumed_gain * realization_fraction - migration_and_running_costs
buyer_value_illustration.interpretation: Illustrative arithmetic only: 10 million billed vCPU-hours/year and 5% reducible usage are assumed. Reordering without lower billed duration yields zero compute savings; memory and deadline value are separate. This example does not establish sufficient demand or price.

portfolio_screen.beneficiary: Technical owner of a formal non-safety-critical scheduling, batching or planning workflow.
portfolio_screen.artifact: Purpose-preserving policy module, independent original-constraint checker, held-out comparison, narrow adapter and reproducible manifest.
portfolio_screen.alpha_test: Additional net mission advantage over competent current frontier plus strong existing solvers and recipient-available methods, with full acquisition/build/validation/integration/upkeep cost.
portfolio_screen.network_test: Fresh disjoint jobs for heterogeneous authenticated recipients; mandatory network discoverability after shareable admission, optional adoption, reconstruction/adaptation cost and overlap measured.
portfolio_screen.moving_beta: A better ordinary solver/frontier workflow can erase resource or reliability advantage; revalidation can retain, supersede or retire the asset.
portfolio_screen.reason: Original objectives are machine-evaluable; strong public baselines exist; structurally related problems permit falsifiable transfer. The market value and Alpha effect distributions remain uncertain.
portfolio_screen.decisive_failure: No net gain against the strong baseline after full costs, no recipient gain, omitted constraint, false graph admission, or advantage absorbed by moving Beta.

portfolio_screen.artifact: Narrow executable module with explicit contracts/proof or independent oracle and tested adapter.
portfolio_screen.alpha_test: Reusable abstraction or verifier reduces complete construction/validation cost on new specifications beyond current libraries and frontier competence.
portfolio_screen.network_test: Fresh recipient projects with actual specification overlap; unrelated downloads do not count as value.
portfolio_screen.moving_beta: A public library, standard tool or stronger baseline can internalize the abstraction.
portfolio_screen.reason: Good executable validation, but useful transfer depends on specification compatibility; proof does not establish unstated intent.
portfolio_screen.decisive_failure: Proof of the wrong specification or adaptation cost exceeding the avoided work.

portfolio_screen.artifact: Executable candidate design/parameterization with uncertainty and simulator evidence; physical validation excluded.
portfolio_screen.alpha_test: A new representation or experiment policy yields better designs within the original simulator and full resource budget.
portfolio_screen.network_test: Transfer across compatible simulators/material models; validation scope and calibration provenance preserved.
portfolio_screen.moving_beta: Improved solvers or surrogate models reduce advantage.
portfolio_screen.reason: Ambitious and valuable, but the simulator-to-physical-world bridge adds a material external-validity burden.
portfolio_screen.decisive_failure: Simulation gain fails intended-use credibility or requires unmodeled physical/professional work.

portfolio_screen.artifact: Executable allocation or incentive protocol and adversarial simulator.
portfolio_screen.alpha_test: Improved mission welfare or robustness after complete costs under unchanged authorized objectives.
portfolio_screen.network_test: Participant behavior and equilibrium responses matter; reusable code alone is insufficient.
portfolio_screen.moving_beta: Public mechanisms and adaptive participants can remove an advantage.
portfolio_screen.reason: Preferences, strategic responses and willingness to pay are presently too weakly calibrated for a fast primary commercial claim.
portfolio_screen.decisive_failure: Unmodeled behavior reverses the predicted benefit or no buyer pays for the scoped artifact.

Human-service provider necessarily works without AI
High human cost implies automatic demand
Lower makespan automatically equals cloud bill savings
More solved instances equals better invention ability
A retained file implies a new capability absent from frontier baseline
A prototype handoff is equivalent to full production/physical integration
Profitable Beta delivery proves incremental Alpha
A graph node, download, attestation or Merkle proof establishes net value
Sharing value follows from adding agents or compute
An admitted asset remains Alpha after Beta improves
Private access guarantees permanent rarity or prevents authorized copying
